reply_text:
Nadia, I've replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-pod. I found four Vantorre Group (parent) tickets in the three places you named, and each has its source in the reply.

- **#8841 (also written #PD-8841):** This is the Allentown gate kiosk ticket. It shows up in the Moss digests of 4/27, 5/4 and 9/30, and in Gideon's Jul 1 message in #strategic-pod.
- **INC-4821:** This is the status-page access screenshot from the Hartford outage. Gideon posted it in #inc-vtg-hartford on Aug 3.
- **VT-55120:** This is the root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, which Gideon posted in the same channel on Oct 14. I haven't opened it, so I can't confirm what's attached.
- **#PD-4418:** This is a Dock Door 9 export ticket from the 9/15/2025 digest. The digest only says "the account Nadia runs", so I can't confirm it's Vantorre Group. I flagged it as needing a check.

The history of #8841 conflicts. Gideon said he closed it on Jul 1, but the 9/30 digest describes it as newly submitted, and at Newark rather than Allentown. Support's own record should settle which is right before this goes to Mateo.

I left out #4812, which is Vantorre Mobility, and #PD-4402, which is Quillfeather. Trailer 8836 in the Hartford room is a trailer number, not a ticket.

This only covers those three sources. I didn't check the support system itself, so it may not be the complete ticket history.
